niche: a motor insurer's 2025 private-car claim frequency by sales region for a 2027 telematics pilot, the injury claims that claims-management companies notify months and years after the accident still to come
answer: Mersey and Pennine host the 2027 telematics pilot: 8.9 and 8.2 claims per 100 car-years in accident year 2025, Severn third at 8.0 (gap 0.2), Wessex 7.3, Fenland 5.9
answer_source: submission.md block 1 and generator/figures.json (frequency, call, gap)
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every filed rule, builds each region's 2025 earned car-years and completes its 2025 claims still to be notified with the region's own development from the closed accident years, by head of claim, or by the claims system's notified-by field, names Mersey and Severn, because each of those developments carries the notifying mix of the years it was measured on, and Pennine's 2025 injury claims came through claims-management companies, which notify far later than solicitors, about three times as often as before; only the development split by the representative's firm type, built from the representatives register, reproduces accident year 2022 in every region as the reserving standard requires, and it puts Pennine second.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each region's ultimate claim count for accident year 2025, the claims notified and those incurred but not yet notified, per earned car-year, which the field develops from notified counts with report-lag factors on groups whose lags are stable and validates against closed accident years; here the lag is carried by who notifies the claim, a claims-management company notifying injury claims near the three-year limitation period, and a noun swap to another field loses the notification route, the limitation period and the accident-year development the call rests on.
layer1: the claims-system migration of 3 July 2023: legacy references and date-only notifications beside the new system's UTC timestamps in one column
the pricing mart's change of layout between the 2022 and 2023 sheets (region, product and cover codes and vehicle-days against names and car-years)
vans in the claims extract and the exposure workbook beside the private cars
open accident years 2023, 2024 and 2026 in the extract beside the years the call reads

spine.grain: claim: one claimant's claim under one head from one accident

driver: The decisive quantity is the eventual count of events from a closed period, completed from those reported so far with lag factors taken per reporting route, where the route is built by joining each report's representative to a register of firm types, because one route reports far later than the others and one unit's mix shifted toward it; completing each unit with its own past lag pattern, by event kind or by the coarse reporter field under-counts that unit, and only the route split reproduces an earlier closed period that a past shift in another unit disturbed, as a filed back-test requires.
driver_concrete: Each region's 2025 claim frequency counts the claims still to be notified, completed with report-lag factors by the notifying representative's firm type from the representatives register, because claims-management companies notify injury claims months and years late and Pennine's 2025 injury claims came through them about three times as often as before; Pennine's own past development, the head-of-claim split and the notified-by field each fail the reserving standard's back-test on accident year 2022, which a claims-management wave in Wessex disturbed, and only the firm-type split passes it.
stump: The default path completes each region's 2025 claims still to be notified with the region's own development from the closed accident years, by head of claim or by the notified-by field, and names Mersey and Severn, because claims-management companies notify injury claims months and years after the accident and Pennine's 2025 injury claims came through them about three times as often as before; developed by the representative's firm type, the only split that reproduces accident year 2022 in every region, Pennine's 2025 frequency is the second highest.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many people are at each small area on a typical day, known completely only as the members attached to each area and observed day by day only in a broad sample whose on-site rate falls with how far a member lives from the area; carrying the sample's rate for each kind of member onto the complete attachments credits the areas that draw their members from far away with too many present, so the rate has to be carried within the groups it varies across.
lineage.architecture: v1 (a quick-commerce grocer's 2027 weekday dark-store pilot among six metros, by each core's delivery-weighted density of people present, the commuting table's flows carried at a national survey's days on the premises)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-18 at stage 4: the isolated reader carried the survey's share by industry group and HOMEREL onto every flow by reflex and committed the golden call, Tessavon at 28,805 against Corrisford's 21,709 (score_reader.py exit 1); the stratum was a classifier both sources share, so the careful analyst's first group-by; the judge found the call forced, Gate H passing, and two ask forks

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how far each area's stock has fallen, observable either through the records of collectors who choose where to sample by how much they find there or through a fixed probability sample of the whole area; as a stock shrinks it retreats into the best part of its area and the collectors follow it, so their catch per unit of effort holds up while the stock falls and the parts they abandon drop out of their record, and only the fixed sample, weighted over the whole area, shows the fall.
lineage.architecture: v2 (re-rooted 2026-10-18 after architecture 1's stage-4 reader landed the call)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-18 at stage 4: the isolated reader went to the autumn survey first and weighted each depth band by its share of the stock area from plan 4.2's estimand and the manual's equal stations per band, committing Halmorie Deep at 63 per cent against Brettach Bank's 52 with every fall (score_reader.py exit 1); a survey whose own manual describes its strata under an estimand filed as a total over an area makes the design-based estimate the careful analyst's default; the judge found the call forced, DETERMINISTIC and APPROVE

lineage.architecture: v3 (registry heart failure survival, the patients lost to a move north carried from their NYHA class at the move)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the share of units still free of an event a fixed time after their start, from a record that loses sight of units once they leave its reach, where units leave far more often after their recorded state has worsened; treating each loss as ordinary censoring credits the departed with the survival of the units still followed, so each departed unit's survival has to be carried from the state it was in when lost, through the moves between states and the state-specific event rates the followed units show.
